        group1 = inputs[:, :, :, :tf.shape(inputs)[-1] // 3]
        group2 = inputs[:, :, :, tf.shape(inputs)[-1] // 3:2 * tf.shape(inputs)[-1] // 3]
        group3 = inputs[:, :, :, 2 * tf.shape(inputs)[-1] // 3:]

        out1 = self.conv1x1(group1)
